pages.title: Megatherium
pages.text: The Megatherium ($(o)Megatherium americanum$()) is an extinct giant ground sloth that lived in South America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at its end.$(br2)It was one of the largest land mammals of its time, reaching about six metres from head to tail and weighing as much as an elephant.$(br2)Megatherium could rear up on its hind legs, bracing itself on its thick tail, to reach high branches with its long, clawed forelimbs.
